1: # Minimum Bootable NSH System defconfig Reference
2: 
3: \[ English | [简体中文](../../../../zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/defconfig_reference/minimum_nsh_baseline.md) \]
4: 
5: This document targets contestants of the Hardware Porting Track. The goal is to help contestants **boot to the NSH command-line prompt on their development board first**. The recommended workflow is: start from the minimum set provided in this document, verify that the serial console and NSH work correctly, and then incrementally enable subsystems such as filesystem, networking, and sensors.
6: 
7: ## 1. Overview
8: 
9: ### 1.1 Document goal
10: 
11: When a contestant receives a development board not yet supported by openvela, the most critical first step is to bring the system up to the NSH command-line prompt. This document provides a **bare-minimum** reference defconfig that contains only the configuration items required to boot NSH, helping contestants quickly identify:
12: 
13: - Which CONFIGs **must be modified** (strongly tied to target hardware);
14: - Which CONFIGs **can be reused as-is** (hardware-independent runtime support);
15: - After L0 brings up, in which order to **incrementally enable** subsystems.
16: 
17: ### 1.2 Recommended workflow
18: 
19: ```
20: Step 0: Hardware ready
21:         - Target chip is supported under nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/
22:         - Board directory exists at boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/
23:         - Serial TX/RX pins are connected to the host
24:         ↓
25: Step 1: Apply this minimum set → build → flash → see NSH prompt on console
26:         ↓
27: Step 2: Incrementally enable subsystems based on hardware capability
28:         - Filesystem (FAT / LittleFS)
29:         - Networking stack (Ethernet / Wi-Fi)
30:         - Graphics (LCD / framebuffer / LVGL)
31:         - Sensors (uORB / I2C / SPI sensors)
32:         ↓
33: Step 3: Trim for release once porting stabilizes
34:         - Disable DEBUG_*, ALLSYMS, and similar debug items
35:         - Adjust stack sizes based on measured needs
36: ```
37: 
38: ## 2. Minimum NSH required configuration
39: 
40: The configuration items in this section are derived from `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig` (35 lines), and also draw on Mateusz Szafoni's [NuttX small systems blog series](https://www.railab.me/tags/small-systems/) for practical minimization techniques.
41: 
42: ### 2.1 Architecture and board identity (Must be replaced for the target hardware)
43: 
44: ```
45: CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
46: CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32"
47: CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
48: CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32F303RE=y
49: CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="nucleo-f303re"
50: CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_NUCLEO_F303RE=y
51: ```
52: 
53: #### Replacement guidelines
54: 
55: | Item | Replacement guideline |
56: | ---- | ---- |
57: | `CONFIG_ARCH=` | Target CPU architecture, e.g. `"arm"`, `"arm64"`, `"risc-v"`, `"xtensa"` |
58: | `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP=` and `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<FAMILY>=y` | Target SoC family, must match `nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/` (e.g. `stm32`, `stm32h7`, `nrf52`, `esp32s3`) |
59: | `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<DEVICE>=y` | Specific device, e.g. `STM32F407VG`, `NRF52840`, `ESP32S3` |
60: | `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD=` and `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_<NAME>=y` | Board directory name, must match `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/` |
61: 
62: ### 2.2 Memory layout (Must be filled in per target hardware)
63: 
64: ```
65: CONFIG_RAM_START=0x20000000
66: CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=65536
67: CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=2
68: CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC=6522
69: ```
70: 
71: #### Item descriptions
72: 
73: - `CONFIG_RAM_START`: starting physical address of the main SRAM, refer to the target chip's datasheet (most ARM Cortex-M chips use `0x20000000`).
74: - `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE`: main SRAM size in bytes.
75: - `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`: number of memory regions managed by the heap allocator. Adjust accordingly when the chip has multiple discontiguous SRAM blocks (e.g. STM32F4's CCM, STM32H7's AXI/AHB SRAM).
76: - `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC`: busy-wait delay calibration value, related to CPU frequency. May be filled with an estimated value initially and calibrated later via `up_mdelay()`.
77: 
78: ### 2.3 Serial console (Must be replaced per target hardware)
79: 
80: ```
81: CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y
82: CONFIG_USART2_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y
83: CONFIG_STM32_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y
84: ```
85: 
86: #### Replacement guidelines
87: 
88: | Item | Replacement guideline |
89: | ---- | ---- |
90: | `CONFIG_<CHIP>_USART<N>=y` | Enable the target chip's UART peripheral. STM32 uses `STM32_USARTx`, nRF52 uses `NRF52_UART0`, ESP32 uses `ESP32_UART0` |
91: | `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` | Designate that UART as the system console |
92: | `CONFIG_<CHIP>_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y` | Optional per chip; preserves the SWD debug port |
93: 
94: Refer to `board.h` under `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/include/` for pin definitions and confirm that the serial port maps to TX/RX pins matching your hardware design.
95: 
96: ### 2.4 NSH Shell entry point (Reuse as-is)
97: 
98: ```
99: CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
100: CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
101: ```
102: 
103: #### Item descriptions
104: 
105: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`: builds NSH as a system application.
106: - `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"`: makes NSH the first user-mode task after system boot. Once the serial console is connected, the command-line prompt appears.
107: 
108: ### 2.5 Scheduling and runtime support (Reuse as-is)
109: 
110: ```
111: CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
112: CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
113: CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
114: CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
115: CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
116: CONFIG_START_DAY=27
117: CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
118: ```
119: 
120: #### Item descriptions
121: 
122: - `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200`: round-robin scheduling time slice of 200 ms.
123: - `CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y`: enables the `waitpid()` syscall, which NSH relies on when running built-in commands.
124: - `CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4`: pre-allocates 4 POSIX timers, sufficient for basic needs.
125: - `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048`: idle-thread stack size. 2 KB is suitable for most Cortex-M boards. Reduce to 1024 if RAM is tight.
126: - `CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0`: disables task-name strings to save RAM. Set to 16~32 if the `ps` command is needed to display task names.
127: - `CONFIG_START_DAY` and `CONFIG_START_YEAR`: initial date when the system boots; can be set to any reasonable values.
128: 
129: ### 2.6 Debug and diagnostics (Strongly recommended to retain)
130: 
131: ```
132: CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
133: CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
134: CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
135: CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
136: ```
137: 
138: #### Item descriptions
139: 
140: - `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y`: retains debug symbols for GDB single-stepping and backtrace analysis.
141: - `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y`: prints stack contents on hardfault — an essential aid during the porting phase.
142: - `CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y` and `CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y`: produce both `.hex` and `.bin` artifacts after the build.
143: 
144: ### 2.7 CPU feature trimming (Adjust as needed)
145: 
146: ```
147: # CONFIG_ARCH_FPU is not set
148: ```
149: 
150: #### Description
151: 
152: `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU` controls whether the hardware floating-point unit is enabled. Cortex-M4F, M7 and similar cores with FPU should set `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y` if floating-point operations are required. Cortex-M0/M3 cores have no FPU and should leave it disabled.
153: 
154: ### 2.8 Board-level helpers (Optional)
155: 
156: ```
157: CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y
158: ```
159: 
160: #### Description
161: 
162: `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y`: enables the button driver framework when the board has a USER button. Omit if the target board has no buttons.
163: 
164: ## 3. Reusable defconfig fragment
165: 
166: The following 13 items are hardware-independent and may be used as-is on any ARM Cortex-M board:
167: 
168: ```
169: CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
170: CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
171: CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
172: CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
173: CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
174: CONFIG_START_DAY=27
175: CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
176: CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
177: CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
178: CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
179: CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
180: CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
181: CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
182: ```
183: 
184: Contestants only need to fill in the hardware-specific items marked "Must be replaced per target hardware" in Section 2 (architecture identity, memory layout, serial console) to form a complete L0 defconfig.
185: 
186: ## 4. Reference implementations
187: 
188: ### 4.1 Nucleo-F303RE (recommended reference board)
189: 
190: Full defconfig path:
191: 
192: ```
193: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig
194: ```
195: 
196: This board is built around the STM32F303RE (Cortex-M4F @ 72 MHz, 512 KB Flash, 64 KB SRAM) and integrates the ST-Link/V2-1 debugger with a USB virtual serial port. With a single USB cable, contestants can perform both flashing and serial communication, making it the most convenient hardware reference for verifying the minimum-NSH workflow.
197: 
198: ### 4.2 Other minimal NSH defconfigs for reference
199: 
200: | Reference board | Path | Lines | Use case |
201: | ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |
202: | Nucleo-F303RE | `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig` | 35 | Mainstream ARM Cortex-M4F reference |
203: | nRF52840-DK | `nuttx/boards/arm/nrf52/nrf52840-dk/configs/nsh/defconfig` | 41 | Reference for the Nordic nRF52 family |
204: | STM32F411-Minimum | `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/stm32f411-minimum/configs/nsh/defconfig` | 46 | STM32F4 with constrained resources |
205: | STM32F4Discovery | `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/stm32f4discovery/configs/nsh/defconfig` | 50 | Classic STM32F4 evaluation board (includes some extras) |
206: 
207: ## 5. Incrementally enabling subsystems
208: 
209: Once L0 boots successfully (the NSH prompt is visible on the serial console), subsystems can be enabled progressively per the target board's capability. Common CONFIG entry points for each subsystem are:
210: 
211: | Subsystem | Primary CONFIG entry points |
212: | ---- | ---- |
213: | Filesystem (FAT, LittleFS, PROCFS) | `CONFIG_FS_FAT`, `CONFIG_FS_LITTLEFS`, `CONFIG_FS_PROCFS` |
214: | Networking stack (TCP/IP, Wi-Fi) | `CONFIG_NET`, `CONFIG_NET_TCP`, `CONFIG_NET_UDP` |
215: | Graphics and display (fb, LCD, LVGL) | `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`, `CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL` |
216: | Sensors and uORB | `CONFIG_SENSORS`, `CONFIG_UORB` |
217: | Bluetooth (BLE) | `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH`, `CONFIG_NIMBLE` |
218: | Audio | `CONFIG_AUDIO` |
219: | Power management | `CONFIG_PM` |
220: 
221: Contestants may also refer to `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-x86_64-ap/defconfig` (253 lines) as a reference example of openvela's full CONFIG set with all subsystems enabled, useful as a comparison baseline when adding subsystems incrementally.
222: 
223: ## 6. Functional validation
224: 
225: Once subsystems are enabled, it is recommended to validate functional completeness on the target hardware using standardized test cases. The openvela community maintains an xTS test case collection for community developers, covering peripheral drivers, filesystem, networking, media, and other subsystems, which can serve as a functional acceptance reference once a subsystem has been enabled.
226: 
227: ### 6.1 Recommended usage
228: 
229: - **L0 boot validation**: after the minimum set in this document brings up NSH, manually run commands such as `help`, `uname`, and `ps` on the serial console to verify basic shell and syscall behavior.
230: - **Subsystem functional validation**: after enabling each subsystem, run the corresponding test cases from the xTS collection (e.g. run the SPI_I2C tests after enabling the SPI/I2C drivers).
231: - **Regression validation**: once porting stabilizes, the full xTS suite can serve as a regression set for verifying functionality after subsequent configuration changes.
232: 
233: ### 6.2 xTS coverage areas
234: 
235: | Test topic | Applicable scenario |
236: | ---- | ---- |
237: | SPI / I2C drivers | Validate bus communication after peripheral drivers are enabled (includes a BMI160 sensor example) |
238: | Ymodem file transfer | Validate serial-port file transfer capability |
239: | mediatool media tests | Validate audio/video codec and playback pipelines |
240: | Wi-Fi compatibility | Verified-router list and connection-stability validation |
241: | Self-test framework (cmocka) | How to use the framework when authoring custom unit tests |

The xTS test case collection is currently available in Chinese only.
244: 
245: ## 7. New-hardware adaptation Checklist
246: 
247: After completing BSP porting, contestants are advised to validate the defconfig and target-hardware compatibility against the following checklist:
248: 
249: - [ ] `CONFIG_ARCH`, `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP`, and `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD` have been replaced with target-hardware identifiers
250: - [ ] `CONFIG_RAM_START` and `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE` have been filled in per the target chip's datasheet
251: - [ ] For chips with multiple SRAM regions (e.g. STM32F4 with CCM), `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS` has been set correctly
252: - [ ] The serial peripheral macro (e.g. `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y`) has been switched to the target chip's UART
253: - [ ] `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` is consistent with the pin definitions in `board.h`

1. **D13x 芯片定位清晰**：国产 RISC-V MCU，主打全高清显示 + 智能控制，适合工业 HMI、智能面板等场景。衡山派开发板（D133EBS）是大赛指定硬件。

148:  *

151:  *   reg    - I2C Register to be read

161:                           uint16_t reg,

165:   int ret;

190:

192:       .addr      = dev->addr,
193:       .flags     = I2C_M_READ,
194:       .buffer    = buf,
195:       .length    = buflen
196:     }

202:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c && buf);
203:

205:

### NuttX GT9XX 驱动接口
- gt9xx_register(devpath, i2c_dev, i2c_addr, board_config)
- gt9xx_board_s: irq_attach, irq_enable, set_power
- I2C 消息: I2C_M_READ, I2C_M_NOSTOP
- 设备节点: /dev/input0

### 硬件信息
- 屏幕: 1024x600 LVDS，4.3寸电容触摸
- GT911 触摸: I2C 地址 0x5D, RST=PA0, INT=PA2
- LVDS 连接器: PD.18-PD.27 (数据线)
- 触摸连接器: 6-pin (RST/VDD/GND/INT/SDA/SCL)

- I2C 驱动必须实现 i2c_ops_s (transfer/setup/shutdown)
- LVDS 驱动必须提供 fb_s 给 NuttX FB 框架

## D13x平台LCD+GT911触摸屏驱动移植方案

### 1. 需要创建/修改的文件

**新建文件**:
1. `artinchip_i2c.c` — DesignWare I2C控制器驱动
2. `artinchip_lvds.c` — LVDS显示控制器驱动

5. `artinchip_boot.c` — 板级初始化代码
6. `defconfig` — 配置选项

### 2. 核心实现要点

**I2C驱动**:
- DesignWare IP寄存器布局 (不是简单CR/SR)
- Fast Mode 400KHz时序: HCNT≥600, LCNT≥1300
- **必须加clamp保护**: `if (hcnt < 600) hcnt = 600;`
- FIFO depth=8, RX threshold=4

**LVDS显示**:
- LVDS控制器: 0x18810000
- LCD控制器: 0x18800000  
- DE: 0x18A00000
- **fb_videoinfo_s.fmt 必须设为 FB_FMT_RGB32**
- 1024x600 Single Link, VESA/JEIDA模式

**GT911触摸**:
- 使用NuttX内置gt9xx.c驱动
- I2C地址: 0x5D (INT=LOW)
- RST=PA0, INT=PA2
- 需要实现gt9xx_board_s回调

### 3. 编译配置

```kconfig
CONFIG_I2C=y
CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER=y
CONFIG_INPUT=y
CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX=y
CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C=y
CONFIG_VIDEO_FB=y
CONFIG_I2C_REGISTER=y
```

### 4. 初始化流程

```
board_app_initialize()
  → artinchip_i2c_initialize(0)    // 初始化I2C0
  → i2c_register("/dev/i2c0")      // 注册I2C设备
  → gt9xx_register("/dev/input0")   // 注册触摸设备
  → artinchip_lvds_initialize()    // 初始化LVDS控制器
  → fb_register(0, 0)              // 注册FB设备
```

### 5. 验证方法

```bash
# 编译验证
make distclean
./tools/configure.sh -l ../vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/configs/nsh
make -j$(nproc)

# 代码大小检查
riscv-none-elf-size nuttx  # 目标: < 12MB

# 功能验证
nsh> ls /dev  # 应看到 /dev/i2c0, /dev/input0, /dev/fb0
```

### 6. 关键注意事项

1. **fb_videoinfo_s.fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32** — 默认值0是单色模式
2. **I2C时序必须加clamp** — pclk/freq可能低于最小值
3. **fb_register 必须在 board_app_initialize() 中调用**
4. **检查 board_app_initialize 重复定义** — 两个文件不能同时定义
5. **NuttX GT9xx 驱动需要 gt9xx_board_s 板级回调**

### 7. 代码大小估算

| 模块 | 预估大小 |
|------|----------|
| I2C驱动 | 800-1200 bytes |
| LVDS显示 | 2000-3000 bytes |
| GT911触摸 | 400-600 bytes |
| 板级初始化 | 200-400 bytes |

31: - NuttX CONFIG_STACK_USAGE_WARNING=0 必须显式设置，unset 会导致空 `-Wstack-usage=` 参数。
32: - NuttX RISC-V 需要大量隐式 CONFIG_ 选项: NCPUS, NFILE_DESCRIPTORS_PER_BLOCK, TASK_NAME_SIZE, LIBC_MAX_EXITFUNS 等。
33: - d13x_head.S 在 make distclean 时会被删除，需要确保 Make.defs 中 HEAD_ASRC 引用时文件存在。
34: - d13x_os.its 的 load/entry 地址必须匹配 SRAM (0x30040000)，不能用 bootloader 的 0x20000000。
35: - Pack 需要 toolchain 在 vendor/artinchip/toolchain/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf- (objcopy, size)。
36: - **PBP 资源是烧录成功的关键**: pbp_cfg.bin + d13x.pbp 包含 PSRAM 训练、UART 引脚、JTAG 配置、boot pin 检测。缺少这些导致 bootloader 不认识分区 → 烧录失败。添加后烧录成功。
37: - **D13x OpenVela 显示驱动状态**: LVDS 驱动已实现 (artinchip_lvds.c)。LCD/DE/GE/VE (0x18800000-0x18C00000) 仍无驱动代码。需要从 luban-lite 移植。
38: - **luban-lite 显示栈结构**: DE HAL (682行) + DBI/DSI (744行) + panel drivers + drv_fb.c (865行, RT-Thread)。完整移植工作量大。
39: - **NuttX fb_area_s 用 x/y/w/h**: 不是 x1/y1/x2/y2。fb_planeinfo_s 用 fbmem/fblen。fb_vtable_s 没有 updatearea。
40: - **16MB Flash 是硬限制**: rodata:10m + 其他分区总和超过 16MB。必须在 rodata 和 data 之间平衡。
41: - **Entry point 0x30100100 (+0x100)**: demo88-nor 使用 +0x100 偏移跳过 AIC image header。
42: - **image_cfg.json 段名**: demo88-nor 用 `temporary`，我们用 `pre-process`。两者都 work with pack.sh。
43: - **fb_videoinfo_s.fmt 必须显式设置**: 默认值 0 是 FB_FMT_Y1 (单色)。32bpp RGB888 显示必须设为 FB_FMT_RGB32 (值 13)。
44: - **fb_register 必须在 board_late_initialize 中调用**: NuttX 帧缓冲设备需要显式调用 fb_register(0, 0) 才会注册 /dev/fb0。
45: - **D13x 外设地址和 IRQ 全部验证通过**: chip.h 中 37 个基地址、irq.h 中 38 个 IRQ 号与 luban-lite aic_soc.h 完全一致。
46: - **SSD1306 配置冲突**: CONFIG_LCD_SSD1306=y 与 LVDS 驱动同时编译会导致资源争用。使用 LVDS 时必须从 defconfig 中移除所有 SSD1306 相关选项。[ses_0ec1a1fd4ffeql27SWB7VUIEiW]
47: - **board_app_initialize 重复定义**: artinchip_boot.c + artinchip_appinit.c 都定义 board_app_initialize()。Makefile 无条件编译两个文件（CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y），导致 duplicate symbol。需要从其中一个文件中移除。[ses_0ec1a1fd4ffeql27SWB7VUIEiW]
48: - **D13x 启动/CLIC/UART 全部验证通过**: head.S (GP/SP/BSS/data/start_c), CLIC (0x20800000 + 0x1000), UART (DLAB, WAIT_IDLE, recvchars) 均正确。
49: - **并行代码审查成功捕获 3 个 bug**: (1) g_videoinfo.fmt 未设置, (2) 缺少 string.h, (3) fb_register 从未调用。全部在最终构建前修复。
50: - **artinchip_boot.c 需要 fb.h**: 调用 fb_register() 必须 #include <nuttx/video/fb.h>。
51: - **D13x NSH shell 启动后不响应**: 串口在 "Run APP" 后完全静默。根因: 缺少 riscv_earlyserialinit() 调用 + 缺少 CONFIG_DEV_CONSOLE + board_app_initialize 重复定义。源码已修复但板上 prebuilt 固件可能不含这些修复。
52: - **'D' 字符诊断法**: artinchip_start.c:537 在 nx_start() 前写 'D' 到 UART0。如果串口未收到 'D'，说明 __start_c() 未被到达或 UART 重初始化破坏连接。这是排查启动问题的关键诊断线索。
53: - **prebuilt 固件与源码不同步**: prebuilt nuttx.bin (215587字节) 可能不含近期修复。烧录前需确认固件是最新编译的。
54: - **include/chip.h 引用路径问题**: vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/include/chip.h 做 `#include "../../chip.h"` → 解析到不存在的 vendor/artinchip/chip.h。但 artinchip_uart.c 用 `#include "chip.h"` → 解析到正确的本地 chip.h。
55: - **串口权限每次打开需要重设**: `echo '1q2w3e4rQ' | sudo -S chmod 666 /dev/ttyACM0`
56: - **GT911 触摸 I2C 地址 0x5D**: INT=LOW 时 0x5D, INT=HIGH 时 0x14。RST=PA0, INT=PA2。[ses_0ec1a1fd4ffeql27SWB7VUIEiW]
57: - **GT911 触摸面板规格**: Sensor 164x99mm, Lens 163.85x98.85mm, 3.3V, PET 0.25mm, OCA 0.15mm, ITO 1.1mm。
58: - **NuttX GT9xx 驱动需要板级回调**: gt9xx_register() 需要 gt9xx_board_s (irq_attach, irq_enable, set_power)。必须在板级代码中实现。
59: - **LVDS 控制器在 0x18810000**: D13x 有独立的 LVDS 控制器，与 LCD 控制器 (0x18800000) 分开。1024x600 面板需要 DE + LVDS PHY。
60: - **NuttX LVDS 驱动已实现**: artinchip_lvds.c — 1024x600 framebuffer, test pattern stripes, LVDS registers at 0x18810000. [ses_0ec1a1fd4ffeql27SWB7VUIEiW]
61: - **D13x 显示驱动移植计划**: 4阶段工作流 — (1) Reading Agents 并行读取文档/源码/硬件资料, (2) Writing Agents 分工编写LCD/Touch/Board配置, (3) Reviewing Agents 并行审查代码, (4) 编译验证与迭代修复。
62: - **Display driver Agent roles**: R1=平台专家(D13x文档+OpenVela规范), R2=源码专家(luban-lite+openvela现状), R3=显示硬件专家(屏幕PDF+Image), R4=触摸IC专家(GT911 PDF)。W1=LCD驱动, W2=触摸驱动, W3=Board配置。
63: - **DesignWare I2C IP 寄存器布局 (D13x)**: I2C_CTL=0x00 (bit0=master, bit4-5=speed, bit6=restart_en), I2C_TAR=0x04, I2C_DATA_CMD=0x10 (bit8=READ, bit9=STOP, bit10=RESTART), I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT=0x20, I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT=0x24, I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT=0x28, I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT=0x2C, I2C_INTR_MASK=0x38, I2C_INTR_CLR=0x3C, I2C_ENABLE=0x48, I2C_ENABLE_STATUS=0x4C, I2C_STATUS=0x50, I2C_TXFLR=0x98, I2C_RXFLR=0x9C, I2C_RX_TL=0x90, I2C_TX_TL=0x94。FIFO depth=8。
64: - **I2C Fast Mode 时序 (100MHz PCLK)**: HCNT≥600, LCNT≥1300 for 400KHz。公式: HCNT = pclk/freq - 1, LCNT = pclk/freq。不是 pclk/(freq*3)。**必须加 clamp**: `if (hcnt < 600) hcnt = 600; if (lcnt < 1300) lcnt = 1300;` 因为 pclk/freq 在 100MHz/400KHz 时只产生 250，低于最小值。**I2C FIFO RX threshold 应为 FIFO_DEPTH/2 (4)**，不是 FIFO_DEPTH/2-1 (3)。[ses_0ec1a1fd4ffeql27SWB7VUIEiW]

66: - **并行 Agent 审计方法有效**: 5 个并行 agent 可同时验证芯片地址、寄存器映射、API 合规性和配置一致性。这是标准迭代流程。

# D13x平台LCD+GT911触摸屏驱动移植方案

## 1. 需要创建/修改的文件列表

### 新建文件
1. `vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_i2c.c` — DesignWare I2C控制器驱动
2. `vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_lvds.c` — LVDS显示控制器驱动  
3. `vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/src/artinchip_gt911.c` — GT911触摸屏板级回调

### 需要修改的文件
4. `vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/Make.defs` — 添加新驱动源文件
5. `vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/src/artinchip_boot.c` — 板级初始化代码
6. `vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/configs/nsh/defconfig` — 配置选项
7. `vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/include/irq.h` — 添加I2C IRQ号（如果缺失）

---

## 2. 每个文件的实现要点

### 2.1 artinchip_i2c.c — DesignWare I2C控制器驱动

**目标**: 实现NuttX `i2c_ops_s` 接口，支持I2C0/I2C1/I2C2

**关键设计点**:
- DesignWare I2C IP寄存器布局（不是简单的CR/SR）
- Fast Mode 400KHz时序: HCNT≥600, LCNT≥1300 (100MHz PCLK)
- FIFO depth=8, RX threshold=4 (FIFO_DEPTH/2)
- 必须加clamp保护: `if (hcnt < 600) hcnt = 600;`

**寄存器映射** (来自luban-lite hal_i2c.h):
```c
#define I2C_CTL          0x00  // bit0=master, bit4-5=speed, bit6=restart_en
#define I2C_TAR          0x04  // target address
#define I2C_DATA_CMD     0x10  // bit8=READ, bit9=STOP, bit10=RESTART
#define I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT  0x20  // Standard Mode HCNT
#define I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT  0x24  // Standard Mode LCNT
#define I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT  0x28  // Fast Mode HCNT
#define I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT  0x2C  // Fast Mode LCNT
#define I2C_INTR_MASK    0x38  // 中断掩码
#define I2C_INTR_CLR     0x3C  // 中断清除
#define I2C_ENABLE       0x48  // 使能控制
#define I2C_ENABLE_STATUS 0x4C // 使能状态
#define I2C_STATUS       0x50  // 状态寄存器
#define I2C_TXFLR        0x98  // TX FIFO Level
#define I2C_RXFLR        0x9C  // RX FIFO Level
#define I2C_RX_TL        0x90  // RX Threshold
#define I2C_TX_TL        0x94  // TX Threshold
```

**i2c_ops_s 实现**:
```c
struct i2c_ops_s artinchip_i2c_ops = {
  .transfer = artinchip_i2c_transfer,  // 核心传输函数
  .setup    = artinchip_i2c_setup,     // 设置时序/地址
  .shutdown = artinchip_i2c_shutdown   // 关闭控制器
};
```

**I2C0配置**:
- 基地址: 0x19220000
- IRQ: 84
- PCLK: 100MHz (PLL_FRA2/分频)

**实现要点**:
```c
// 1. 初始化时设置时序
static void artinchip_i2c_settiming(struct artinchip_i2c_s *priv)
{
  uint32_t pclk = 100000000;  // 100MHz
  uint32_t freq = 400000;     // 400KHz
  uint32_t hcnt = pclk / freq - 1;
  uint32_t lcnt = pclk / freq;
  
  // 关键: clamp保护
  if (hcnt < 600) hcnt = 600;
  if (lcnt < 1300) lcnt = 1300;
  
  putreg32(hcnt, priv->base + I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT);
  putreg32(lcnt, priv->base + I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT);
}

// 2. 传输函数处理I2C_M_READ和I2C_M_NOSTOP
static int artinchip_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
                                   struct i2c_msg_s *msgs,
                                   int count)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
    if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ) {
      // 读操作: 发送地址+READ位，然后读取数据
    } else {
      // 写操作: 发送地址+数据
    }
    // 处理I2C_M_NOSTOP标志
  }
}
```

**内存占用**: ~800-1200字节代码

---

### 2.2 artinchip_lvds.c — LVDS显示控制器驱动

**目标**: 实现NuttX `fb_s` 接口，支持1024x600 LVDS显示

**关键设计点**:
- LVDS控制器: 0x18810000
- LCD控制器: 0x18800000  
- DE (Display Engine): 0x18A00000
- IRQ: LCD=55, DE=59
- 1024x600面板，Single Link，VESA/JEIDA模式
- fb_videoinfo_s.fmt 必须设为 FB_FMT_RGB32

**LVDS寄存器映射** (来自luban-lite drv_lvds.c):
```c
#define LVDS_CTL         0x00  // 控制寄存器
#define LVDS_CK_CFG      0x10  // 时钟配置
#define LVDS_0_SWAP      0x20  // Lane 0 数据交换
#define LVDS_1_SWAP      0x24  // Lane 1 数据交换
#define LVDS_0_POL       0x28  // Lane 0 极性
#define LVDS_1_POL       0x2C  // Lane 1 极性
#define LVDS_0_PHY       0x30  // Lane 0 PHY控制
#define LVDS_1_PHY       0x34  // Lane 1 PHY控制
```

**时钟配置**:
```c
// PLL_FRA2 → SCLK → PIX
// 1024x600@60Hz 需要 Pixel Clock ≈ 51MHz
// PLL_FRA2 输出 ≈ 306MHz, 分频得到 51MHz
```

**fb_s 接口实现**:
```c
struct fb_vtable_s artinchip_lvds_vtable = {
  .fb_info    = artinchip_lvds_info,      // 返回fb_videoinfo_s
  .fb_planeinfo = artinchip_lvds_planeinfo, // 返回fb_planeinfo_s
  .fb_updatearea = NULL,  // LVDS不需要主动更新
  .fb_setpower = artinchip_lvds_setpower  // 电源控制
};
```

**关键数据结构**:
```c
static struct fb_videoinfo_s g_videoinfo = {
  .fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32,  // 必须显式设置！
  .xres = 1024,
  .yres = 600,
  .nplanes = 1
};

static struct fb_planeinfo_s g_planeinfo = {
  .bpp = 32,
  .fblen = 1024 * 600 * 4  // RGB32 = 4字节
};
```

**初始化序列**:
1. 配置PLL时钟 (PLL_FRA2)
2. 初始化LVDS PHY
3. 配置LVDS Lane映射
4. 设置显示模式 (VESA/JEIDA)
5. 启用DE和LCD控制器
6. 调用 `fb_register(0, 0)` 注册 `/dev/fb0`

**内存占用**: ~2000-3000字节代码

---

### 2.3 artinchip_gt911.c — GT911触摸屏板级回调

**目标**: 实现NuttX `gt9xx_board_s` 结构体，注册触摸设备

**关键设计点**:
- 使用NuttX内置gt9xx.c驱动 (957行)
- 只需实现板级回调函数
- I2C地址: 0x5D (INT=LOW)
- RST=PA0, INT=PA2

**gt9xx_board_s 实现**:
```c
static int gt911_irq_attach(void (*handler)(void *arg), void *arg)
{
  // 挂载GPIO中断到PA2
  // 使用irq_attach(ARTINCHIP_IRQ_GPIO + 2, handler, arg)
  return 0;
}

static void gt911_irq_enable(bool enable)
{
  // 使能/禁用PA2中断
  if (enable) {
    up_enable_irq(ARTINCHIP_IRQ_GPIO + 2);
  } else {
    up_disable_irq(ARTINCHIP_IRQ_GPIO + 2);
  }
}

static void gt911_set_power(int power)
{
  // 控制RST引脚PA0
  // power=1: 拉高PA0释放复位
  // power=0: 拉低PA0复位触摸IC
  // 注意: 使用up_gpio_set()或直接操作寄存器
}

struct gt9xx_board_s g_gt911_board = {
  .irq_attach  = gt911_irq_attach,
  .irq_enable  = gt911_irq_enable,
  .set_power   = gt911_set_power
};
```

// 注册GT911触摸设备
gt9xx_register("/dev/input0", i2c, 0x5D, &g_gt911_board);
```

### 2.4 artinchip_boot.c — 板级初始化代码

**修改目标**: 在 `board_app_initialize()` 中完成所有外设注册

**关键实现**:
```c
#include <nuttx/config.h>
#include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
#include <nuttx/video/fb.h>
#include <nuttx/input/gt9xx.h>

// 外部函数声明

extern int gt9xx_register(const char *devpath, struct i2c_master_s *dev,
                          uint8_t addr, struct gt9xx_board_s *board);

int board_app_initialize(uintptr_t arg)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_I2C
  // 1. 初始化I2C0总线
  struct i2c_master_s *i2c0 = artinchip_i2c_initialize(0);
  if (i2c0) {
    i2c_register(i2c0, "/dev/i2c0");
  }
#endif

#ifdef CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX
  // 2. 注册GT911触摸设备
  extern struct gt9xx_board_s g_gt911_board;
  gt9xx_register("/dev/input0", i2c0, 0x5D, &g_gt911_board);
#endif

#ifdef CONFIG_VIDEO_FB
  // 3. 初始化LVDS显示
  extern void artinchip_lvds_initialize(void);
  artinchip_lvds_initialize();
  
  // 4. 注册FB设备
  fb_register(0, 0);  // /dev/fb0
#endif

  return 0;
}
```

# D13x 平台 LCD 显示 + GT911 触摸屏驱动移植计划

## 一、当前状态总结

### 已完成
- D13x 最小系统启动：head.S → artinchip_start.c → nx_start() → UART0 → nsh shell
- 芯片层 6 个文件完整（start/irq/lowputc/uart/oneshot/allocateheap）
- defconfig 已启用 I2C、GT9XX、VIDEO_FB 相关 CONFIG 选项
- NuttX 内置 gt9xx.c (957行) + fb.c (1840行) 驱动已存在

### 缺失（本次需创建）
| 组件 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| artinchip_i2c.c | DesignWare I2C 控制器驱动（NuttX i2c_ops_s） |
| artinchip_lvds.c | LVDS 显示控制器驱动（NuttX FB 框架） |
| artinchip_gt911.c | GT911 触摸屏板级回调（gt9xx_board_s） |
| 板级初始化代码 | board_app_initialize() 中注册所有设备 |
| defconfig 补充 | CONFIG_I2C_REGISTER 等 |

---

## 二、硬件参数汇总

### 显示屏
- 分辨率：1024×600，4.3 寸，LVDS 接口
- LVDS 控制器：0x18810000（独立于 LCD 控制器 0x18800000）
- DE (Display Engine)：0x18A00000
- LVDS 信号线：PD.18-PD.27（数据线）
- 模式：Single Link，VESA/JEIDA 24bit

### GT911 触摸
- I2C 地址：0x5D（INT=LOW 时）/ 0x14（INT=HIGH 时）
- RST = PA0，INT = PA2
- 6-pin FPC 连接器（0.5mm 间距）：RST/VDD/GND/INT/SDA/SCL
- I2C 频率：400KHz Fast Mode

### 时钟
- PLL_FRA2 → LVDS 时钟链
- 像素时钟：约 51MHz（1024×600@60fps）
- SCLK = pixelclock × 7 = ~357MHz（Single Link）
- PLL_DISP_FREQ_MIN = 360MHz

---

## 三、实施计划（四阶段）

### 阶段一：多智能体并行阅读与材料总结

启动 4 个并行阅读子智能体：

| Agent | 职责 | 目标文件 |
|-------|------|----------|
| R1 平台专家 | D13x 芯片文档 + OpenVela 移植指南 | `文档/D13x官方资料/ic/media/` (LVDS/LCD/DE/CMU/GPIO 寄存器), `文档/OpenVela官方资料/zh-cn/chip_porting/` |
| R2 源码专家 | luban-lite SDK + openvela 现有代码 | `luban-lite/bsp/artinchip/drv/display/drv_lvds.c`, `luban-lite/bsp/artinchip/hal/i2c/hal_i2c.c`, `luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/touch/gt911/` |
| R3 显示专家 | 屏幕硬件资料 | `文档/GT911 Datasheet.pdf`（触摸面板规格），LVDS 面板时序参数 |
| R4 触摸专家 | GT911 IC 详细规格 | `文档/GT911 Datasheet.pdf`，`luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/touch/gt911/inc/gt911.h`（寄存器定义） |

**主智能体汇总输出**：LCD 控制器配置方案、GPIO 复用表、时序参数、GT911 驱动对接方案。

### 阶段二：多智能体分布式代码编写

启动 3 个并行编写子智能体：

#### Agent W1：I2C 驱动 + LVDS 显示驱动

**文件 1：`vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_i2c.c`**

基于 luban-lite `hal_i2c.c` (387行) + `drv_i2c.c` 适配 NuttX `i2c_ops_s` 接口。

关键实现：
```c
// NuttX I2C ops 结构体（只有 transfer/setup/shutdown）
static const struct i2c_ops_s g_d13x_i2c_ops = {
  .transfer  = d13x_i2c_transfer,
  .setup     = d13x_i2c_setup,
  .shutdown  = d13x_i2c_shutdown,
};

// DesignWare I2C 寄存器（来自 hal_i2c.h）
#define I2C_CTL          0x00   // bit0=master, bit4-5=speed, bit6=restart_en
#define I2C_TAR          0x04
#define I2C_DATA_CMD     0x10   // bit8=READ, bit9=STOP, bit10=RESTART
#define I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT  0x28   // Fast Mode HCNT
#define I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT  0x2C   // Fast Mode LCNT
#define I2C_INTR_MASK    0x38
#define I2C_INTR_CLR     0x3C
#define I2C_ENABLE       0x48
#define I2C_STATUS       0x50
#define I2C_TXFLR        0x98
#define I2C_RXFLR        0x9C
#define I2C_RX_TL        0x90
#define I2C_TX_TL        0x94
```

**关键注意事项**：
- Fast Mode 时序必须加 clamp：`if (hcnt < 600) hcnt = 600; if (lcnt < 1300) lcnt = 1300;`
- FIFO depth=8，RX threshold 应为 FIFO_DEPTH/2 (4)
- I2C 消息标志用 `I2C_M_READ`（不是 I2C_M_RD）
- 需要实现 3 个实例：I2C0(0x19220000,IRQ84), I2C1(0x19221000,IRQ85), I2C2(0x19222000,IRQ86)

**文件 2：`vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_lvds.c`**

基于 luban-lite `drv_lvds.c` (201行) 适配 NuttX FB 框架。

关键实现：
```c
// LVDS 寄存器偏移（来自 aic_hal_lvds.h）
#define LVDS_CTL         0x00
#define LVDS_CK_CFG      0x10
#define LVDS_0_SWAP      0x20
#define LVDS_1_SWAP      0x24
#define LVDS_0_POL_CTL   0x28
#define LVDS_1_POL_CTL   0x2C
#define LVDS_0_PHY_CTL   0x30
#define LVDS_1_PHY_CTL   0x34

// 基地址
#define D13X_LVDS_BASE   0x18810000
#define D13X_LCD_BASE    0x18800000
#define D13X_DE_BASE     0x18A00000
```

关键点：
- fb_videoinfo_s.fmt **必须**设为 FB_FMT_RGB32（值 13），默认 0 是单色
- 时钟链：PLL_FRA2 → SCLK → PIX
- 面板时序：1024×600, pixelclock=51MHz, HBP/HFP/HSW/VBP/VFP/VSW 需从面板规格获取
- LVDS PHY 需要配置 common mode voltage、differential mode voltage、waveform slope
- 1024×600 Single Link 时 SCLK = pixelclock × 7

#### Agent W2：GT911 触摸板级回调

**文件 3：`vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/src/artinchip_gt911.c`**

NuttX 内置 gt9xx.c 驱动需要板级回调 `gt9xx_board_s`：

```c
#include <nuttx/input/gt9xx.h>
#include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>

// GPIO 操作（通过 MMIO 直接操作）
#define D13X_GPIO_BASE  0x18700000
#define PA0  (0 * 32 + 0)  // GT911 RST
#define PA2  (0 * 32 + 2)  // GT911 INT

static int gt911_irq_attach(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state,
                            xcpt_t isr, FAR void *arg);
static void gt911_irq_enable(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool enable);
static int gt911_set_power(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool on);

static const struct gt9xx_board_s g_gt911_board = {
  .irq_attach = gt911_irq_attach,
  .irq_enable = gt911_irq_enable,
  .set_power  = gt911_set_power,
};

// 注册函数
int d13x_gt911_initialize(void) {
  struct i2c_master_s *i2c = i2c_get_device(0);  // I2C0
  gt9xx_register("/dev/input0", i2c, 0x5D, &g_gt911_board);
}
```

关键点：
- I2C 地址 0x5D（INT=LOW），RST=PA0，INT=PA2
- 中断：PA2 需要配置为 GPIO 输入 + 上升沿触发
- 需要通过 GPIO 操作实现 RST 复位序列（拉低→延时→拉高）
- IRQ attach 需要使用 `irq_attach()` + `up_disable_irq()`/`up_enable_irq()`

#### Agent W3：板级初始化 + Make.defs + defconfig

**文件 4：修改 `vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/src/artinchip_boot.c`**

```c
#include <nuttx/config.h>
#include <nuttx/board.h>

322: 
323:             if (stop_time > I2C_TIMEOUT_DEF_VAL) {
324:                 return I2C_TIMEOUT;
325:             }
326:         }
327:     }
328:     return send_count;
329: }

331: /**
332:   \brief       aic_i2c_master_receive_msg
333:   \param[in]   reg_base
334:   \param[in]
335:   \return      bytes of read msg
336: */
337: int32_t aic_i2c_master_receive_msg(unsigned long reg_base,
338:                                    struct aic_i2c_msg *msg)
339: {
340:     CHECK_PARAM(msg, -EINVAL);
341: 
342:     int32_t ret = I2C_OK;
343:     uint16_t size = msg->len;
344:     uint32_t read_count = 0;
345:     uint8_t *receive_data = msg->buf;
346:     uint32_t timeout = 1000;
347:     int idx = 0;
348:     CHECK_PARAM(receive_data, -EINVAL);
349: 
350:     aic_i2c_module_disable(reg_base);
351:     aic_i2c_target_addr(reg_base, msg->addr);
352:     aic_i2c_module_enable(reg_base);
353: 
354:     while (size > 0) {
355:         int32_t recv_num = size > I2C_FIFO_DEPTH ? I2C_FIFO_DEPTH : size;
356:         for (uint16_t len = 0; len < recv_num; len++) {
357:             aic_i2c_read_data_cmd(reg_base);
358:         }
359:         if (recv_num < I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
360:             aic_i2c_read_data_cmd_with_stop_bit(reg_base);
361: 
362:         size -= recv_num;
363:         read_count += recv_num;
364:         ret = aic_i2c_wait_receive(reg_base, recv_num, timeout);
365:         if (ret == I2C_OK) {
366:             for (uint16_t i = 0; i < recv_num; i++) {
367:                 receive_data[idx] = aic_i2c_get_receive_data(reg_base);
368:                 idx++;
369:             }
370:         } else {
371:             read_count = (int32_t)ret;
372:             break;
373:         }
374:     }
375:     if (read_count % I2C_FIFO_DEPTH == 0) {
376:         aic_i2c_transfer_stop_bit(reg_base);
377:     }
378:     uint32_t timecount = timeout + aic_get_time_ms();
379: 
380:     while (!(aic_i2c_get_raw_interrupt_state(reg_base) & I2C_INTR_STOP_DET)) {
381:         if (aic_get_time_ms() >= timecount) {
382:             return I2C_TIMEOUT;
383:             break;
384:         }
385:     }
386:     return read_count;
387: }

import os

import kconfiglib

parser.add_argument("--set-val", "-v")
parser.add_argument("--file", "-f", default=".config")
args, rest = parser.parse_known_args()

    if sym:
        sym.set_value("y")

    sym = kconf.syms.get(args.disable)
    if sym:

    parts = args.set_val.split("=", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        sym = kconf.syms.get(parts[0])
        if sym:
            sym.set_value(parts[1])

SDK_ROOT=$(realpath $CUR_DIR/../../..)

### 3.2 LVGL 显示驱动注册

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/packages/artinchip/lvgl-ui/lv_driver/lv_port_disp.c` (398 行)

3. `fbdev_open()` 初始化 fbdev

`fbdev_flush()` 刷新流程：
- 有 `USE_DRAW_BUF` 时：dcache clean -> GE2D bitblt 从 draw buf 拷贝到 framebuffer -> PAN_DISPLAY
- 无 `USE_DRAW_BUF` 时：直接 dcache clean -> PAN_DISPLAY

- 指针动画使用 `lv_anim` + `lv_img_set_angle`
- 定时器更新 FPS、CPU、内存信息
- FreeType 字体支持（可选）
- FAKE_IMAGE 技巧：用特殊命名的虚拟图像实现纯色填充
- 底部圆点导航指示器

D13X 芯片简化版 (`base_simple_ui.c`, 399 行): 去掉了视频播放器和菜谱页面，仅保留 2 个 Tab。

### 5.3 Meter Demo (仪表盘)

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/packages/artinchip/lvgl-ui/aic_demo/meter_demo/meter_ui.c` (617 行)

汽车仪表盘风格演示（红色背景），包含：
- 中央速度表（指针动画，支持 `LV_METER_SIMPLE_POINT` 旋转模式或预制帧模式）
- 速度数字轮播
- 车速里程表（Trip 计数器）
- 时间显示
- 水温表、电池电量、油量、档位指示
- 发动机/ESP/低油量警告灯闪烁动画
- FPS 和 CPU 使用率显示

动画通过多个 `lv_timer` 驱动（10ms-60s 不等周期）。

### 5.4 Launcher Demo

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/packages/artisanchip/lvgl-ui/aic_demo/launcher_demo/launcher_ui.c` (26 行)

简单 Launcher 界面（注释标注 480x272 分辨率），包含：
- Launcher 主屏幕 (`launcher_screen`)
- Camera 相机屏幕 (`camera_screen`)
- 点击图标切换屏幕

资源文件：FireFox/Maps/Tools/Weather/Mail/iChat/Downloads/Calculator/Camera 等 PNG 图标

### 5.5 GIF Demo

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/packages/artisanchip/lvgl-ui/aic_demo/gif_demo/gif_ui.c` (37 行)

简单 GIF 播放演示：
- 使用 `lv_gif_create()` 创建 GIF 对象
- 播放 `cherub.gif`，单次循环 (`lv_gif_set_loop_count(img, 1)`)
- 监听 `LV_EVENT_READY` 事件检测播放结束

### 5.6 构建系统 (SConscript)

所有 SConscript 文件遵循 SCons 构建模式：
- 顶层 `lvgl-ui/SConscript` -- 条件编译 `aic_ui.c` 和 `lv_demo.c`（依赖 `AIC_LVGL_DEMO`）
- `lv_driver/SConscript` -- 编译所有 `.c` 驱动文件（依赖 `AIC_LVGL_DEMO`）
- `aic_demo/base_demo/SConscript` -- D13X 芯片用 `base_simple_ui.c`，其他用 `base_ui.c`（依赖 `AIC_LVGL_BASE_DEMO`）
- 所有组名统一为 `LVGL-port`

---

## 架构总结

```
应用层:   aic_demo/ (base/meter/launcher/gif)
          |
调度层:   aic_ui.c -> aic_ui_init() 根据宏选择 demo
          |
入口层:   lv_demo.c -> lv_user_gui_init() -> 图像解码器 + UI 初始化
          |
驱动层:   lv_port_disp.c  -> LVGL 显示驱动注册 + fbdev_flush
          lv_ge2d.c       -> GE2D 硬件加速绘图上下文 (替代软件渲染)
          lv_fbdev.c      -> MPP framebuffer 设备抽象
          aic_dec.c       -> 自定义 JPG/PNG 硬件解码器
          lv_port_indev.c -> LVGL 触摸输入设备
          lv_tpc_run.c    -> GT911 触摸面板线程
          |
底层API:  mpp_fb / mpp_ge / mpp_decoder (ArtInChip MPP 框架)
```

关键设计特点：
1. **硬件加速优先** -- 通过自定义绘图上下文将 Blend/Fill/ImageDraw 路由到 GE2D 硬件
2. **FrameBuffer 直连** -- 不使用 LVGL 内置驱动，直接对接 ArtInChip MPP framebuffer
3. **硬件图像解码** -- JPEG/PNG 通过 `mpp_decoder` 硬件解码，避免 CPU 软解
4. **双缓冲支持** -- `AIC_PAN_DISPLAY` + `AICFB_PAN_DISPLAY` 实现 page flip
5. **CMA 内存管理** -- 大块缓冲区使用 CMA 连续内存分配
</actor_result>

---

# Luban-Lite 编译系统分析报告

## 1. 顶层 SCons 构建入口

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/SConstruct`

Luban-Lite 使用 **SCons** 作为构建系统（基于 Python2 + scons）。`SConstruct` 是顶层入口，其执行流程：

1. 调用 `tools/scripts/aic_build.py` 中的 `get_prj_config()` 从 `.config` 读取项目参数（`PRJ_CHIP`, `PRJ_BOARD`, `PRJ_KERNEL`, `PRJ_APP`, `PRJ_DEFCONFIG_NAME`）
2. 从 `bsp/artinchip/sys/<chip>/rtconfig.py` 导入工具链配置（`rtconfig` 模块）
3. 从 `kernel/rt-thread/tools/building.py` 导入 RT-Thread 的 `PrepareBuilding()` / `DoBuilding()`
4. 预处理链接脚本：`gcc_aic.ld.S` → `gcc_aic.ld`
5. 创建 SCons `Environment`，使用 `rtconfig` 中定义的 CC/CXX/AR/LINK 等
6. 调用 `PrepareBuilding()` + `DoBuilding()` 完成编译

**顶层 SConscript** (`/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/SConscript`) 递归引入以下子目录的 SConscript：
- `bsp/artinchip/sys/<PRJ_CHIP>/SConscript` — 芯片级代码
- `target/<PRJ_CHIP>/<PRJ_BOARD>/SConscript` — 板级代码
- `kernel/<PRJ_KERNEL>/SConscript` — RT-Thread 内核
- `kernel/common/SConscript` — 通用内核代码
- `bsp/SConscript` — BSP 驱动（artinchip HAL/drv）
- `packages/SConscript` — 软件包（含 LVGL）
- `application/<PRJ_KERNEL>/<PRJ_APP>/SConscript` — 应用层

---

## 2. bsp/artinchip/ 下的 SConscript 和编译配置

### 2.1 bsp/artinchip/SConscript

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/artinchip/SConscript`

这是 BSP 驱动层的主构建文件（398 行），根据 `.config` 中的 Kconfig 宏（如 `AIC_CMU_DRV`, `AIC_GPIO_DRV`, `AIC_DISPLAY_DRV` 等）条件编译对应的 HAL/drv 源文件。支持三类驱动：
- `drv/` — RT-Thread 设备驱动层
- `hal/` — 硬件抽象层
- `drv_bare/` — 裸机驱动

### 2.2 bsp/artinchip/sys/d13x/SConscript

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/artinchip/sys/d13x/SConscript`

非常简洁，仅编译芯片公共源文件（`*.c`, `*.cpp`, `*.S`），定义 `Chip` 分组，依赖 `AIC_CHIP_D13X` 宏。

### 2.3 Kconfig.chip

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/artinchip/sys/d13x/Kconfig.chip`

定义 D13x 芯片的所有硬件驱动配置选项（750 行），包括：
- `AIC_CHIP_D13X=y` — 芯片标识
- `CPU_BASE=0x20000000` — CPU 基地址
- 各外设驱动版本配置（CMU, GPIO, DMA, UART, I2C, QSPI, Display, GE, VE 等）

---

## 3. D13x 相关的 defconfig 和配置

### 3.1 可用的 D13x 板级

从 `target/d13x/` 目录看，有以下板级：

| 板级 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `demo88-nor` | NOR Flash 方案 |
| `demo88-nand` | NAND Flash 方案 |
| `demo88-mmc` | MMC/eMMC 方案 |
| `demo88-nor-xip` | NOR XIP 方案 |
| `kunlunpi88-nor` | 昆仑派 NOR 方案 |

### 3.2 D13x defconfig 文件

位于 `target/configs/` 目录，格式为 `<chip>_<board>_<kernel>_<app>_defconfig`：

**D13x 已有 defconfig 列表：**
```
d13x_demo88-nor_baremetal_bootloader_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nor_baremetal_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nor_freertos_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nor-xip_baremetal_bootloader_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nor-xip_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nand_baremetal_bootloader_defconfig
d13x_demo88-nand_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_demo88-mmc_baremetal_bootloader_defconfig
d13x_demo88-mmc_baremetal_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_demo88-mmc_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig
d13x_kunlunpi88-nor_baremetal_bootloader_defconfig
d13x_kunlunpi88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig
```

**注意：目前没有 `d13x_*_lvgl_*` 的预置 defconfig。** LVGL 功能需要手动配置启用。

### 3.3 LVGL 相关配置项（从现有 defconfig 中提取）

在 `d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig` 中已包含 LVGL 相关配置：

```
CONFIG_LPKG_USING_LVGL=y
CONFIG_LPKG_LVGL_PATH="/packages/multimedia/LVGL/LVGL"
CONFIG_LPKG_LVGL_THREAD_PRIO=20
CONFIG_LPKG_LVGL_THREAD_STACK_SIZE=32768
CONFIG_LPKG_LVGL_DISP_REFR_PERIOD=5
CONFIG_AIC_LVGL_DEMO=y
CONFIG_AIC_LVGL_METER_DEMO=y
CONFIG_LV_COLOR_DEPTH=16
CONFIG_LV_CACHE_IMG_NUM=8
CONFIG_LVGL_STORAGE_PATH="/rodata/lvgl_data"
```

---

## 4. 编译命令

### 4.1 完整编译流程

```bash
cd /home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite

# 1. 列出所有可用方案
scons --list-def

# 2. 应用一个 defconfig（例如 D13x demo88-nor RT-Thread + helloworld）
scons --apply-def=d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig

# 3. （可选）进入 menuconfig 修改配置，如启用 LVGL
scons --menuconfig

# 4. 编译
scons                  # 标准编译
scons --verbose        # 显示详细编译信息

# 5. 编译产物位置
ls output/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld/images/d13x.elf
ls output/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld/images/d13x.bin
```

### 4.2 OneStep 快捷命令

```bash
cd /home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite
source tools/onestep.sh
lunch          # 交互式选择 defconfig
m              # 编译
c              # clean
```

### 4.3 其他命令

```bash
scons --info              # 查看当前方案信息
scons -c                  # clean
scons --run-qemu          # QEMU 运行（需开启 QEMU 配置）
scons --list-size         # 列出所有 .o 文件大小
scons --pkgs-update       # 在线更新 packages
scons --save-def          # 保存当前配置到 defconfig
scons --distclean         # 清除输出和工具链
scons --add-board         # 创建新板级
```

---

## 5. 工具链路径配置

### 5.1 rtconfig.py 中的配置

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/artinchip/sys/d13x/rtconfig.py`

关键配置：
```python
SOC         = 'd13x'
ARCH        = 'risc-v'
CPU         = 'e9xx'
CPUNAME     = 'e907fdp'
CROSS_TOOL  = 'gcc'
PREFIX      = 'riscv64-unknown-elf-'

# 工具链路径（相对于 rtconfig.py 所在目录）
# Linux/Windows: bsp/artinchip/sys/d13x/../../../../toolchain/bin/
# 即: luban-lite/toolchain/bin/
EXEC_PATH = os.path.normpath(fcwd + '/../../../../toolchain/bin/')

# 可通过环境变量覆盖：
# RTT_EXEC_PATH=/your/custom/toolchain/bin scons
```

工具链前缀和工具：
```
CC      = riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc
CXX     = riscv64-unknown-elf-g++
AR      = riscv64-unknown-elf-ar
LINK    = riscv64-unknown-elf-g++
SIZE    = riscv64-unknown-elf-size
OBJDUMP = riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump
OBJCPY  = riscv64-unknown-elf-objcopy
STRIP   = riscv64-unknown-elf-strip
```

编译选项（`e907fdp`）：
```
-march=rv32imafdcpzpsfoperand_xtheade -mabi=ilp32d
```

### 5.2 工具链自动安装

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/tools/scripts/aic_build.py` (函数 `chk_prepare_toolchain`)

编译时会自动检查并解压工具链：
- 工具链压缩包位于 `tools/toolchain/`
- Linux RISC-V：`Xuantie-900-gcc-elf-newlib-x86_64-V2.6.1-20220906.tar.gz`
- 自动解压到 `toolchain/` 目录（含 `.ready` 标记文件）

### 5.3 环境变量覆盖

```bash
# 自定义工具链路径
export RTT_EXEC_PATH=/opt/riscv/bin

# 自定义 RT-Thread 源码路径
export RTT_ROOT=/path/to/rt-thread

# 自定义环境根目录
export ENV_ROOT=/path/to/env
```

---

## 6. 编译 D13x + LVGL 的完整步骤

由于 **目前没有预置的 D13x + LVGL defconfig**，需要基于现有配置手动启用 LVGL。推荐使用 `d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig` 作为基础（该 defconfig 已包含 LVGL 配置项）。

### 步骤 1：环境准备

```bash
cd /home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite

# 安装依赖（Ubuntu）
sudo apt install python2 python3
pip install scons pycryptodomex
```

### 步骤 2：加载基础 defconfig

```bash
# 查看可用配置
scons --list-def

# 应用 D13x demo88-nor RT-Thread 配置（已包含 LVGL 配置）
scons --apply-def=d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig
```

### 步骤 3：menuconfig 配验 LVGL（可选）

```bash
scons --menuconfig
```

在 menuconfig 中确认/修改：
- `LVGL configuration` → 配置颜色深度（16-bit RGB565 适合大多数屏）
- `LVGL demo select related` → 选择 demo（`CONFIG_AIC_LVGL_DEMO=y`）
- Display 相关 → 配置显示接口（LVDS/MIPI-DSI/RGB 等）
- 配置屏幕分辨率参数（`CONFIG_PANEL_HACTIVE`, `CONFIG_PANEL_VACTIVE` 等）

### 步骤 4：编译

```bash
scons
```

工具链会自动解压到 `toolchain/` 目录。首次编译会下载/解压 Xuantie-900 GCC 工具链。

### 步骤 5：编译产物

```bash
# ELF 固件
output/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld/images/d13x.elf

# BIN 固件
output/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld/images/d13x.bin

# 烧录镜像
output/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld/images/*.img
```

### 关键配置项速查（LVGL）

| 配置项 | 说明 |
|--------|------|
| `CONFIG_LPKG_USING_LVGL=y` | 启用 LVGL 包 |
| `CONFIG_AIC_LVGL_DEMO=y` | 启用 ArtInChip LVGL Demo |
| `CONFIG_AIC_LVGL_METER_DEMO=y` | 选择 Meter Demo |
| `CONFIG_LV_COLOR_DEPTH=16` | LVGL 颜色深度 16-bit |
| `CONFIG_AIC_DISPLAY_DRV=y` | 启用显示驱动 |
| `CONFIG_AIC_DISP_DE_DRV=y` | 启用 Display Engine |
| `CONFIG_AIC_DISP_LVDS=y` / `CONFIG_AIC_DISP_MIPI_DSI=y` | 选择显示接口 |
| `CONFIG_AIC_USING_GE=y` | 启用图形引擎 |
| `CONFIG_AIC_GE_CMDQ=y` | 使用 CMDQ 模式 GE |

### 如果需要自定义板级（含 LVGL）

可使用 OneStep 创建新板级：
```bash
source tools/onestep.sh
scons --add-board  # 交互式创建，基于已有板级复制
```

或直接基于 `d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig` 复制并修改：
```bash
cp target/configs/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_helloworld_defconfig \
   target/configs/d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_myapp_defconfig
# 修改文件中的 CONFIG_PRJ_APP 等配置
scons --apply-def=d13x_demo88-nor_rt-thread_myapp_defconfig
scons
```
</actor_result>

Now I have all the information needed to provide a complete report. Here is the full analysis:

---

## GT911 触摸屏驱动集成完整分析报告

### 1. 目录结构

```
bsp/peripheral/touch/
├── SConscript                          # 构建脚本，条件编译 GT911
└── gt911/
    ├── Kconfig                         # 配置菜单 (I2C通道/RST引脚/INT引脚)
    ├── inc/
    │   └── gt911.h                     # 寄存器定义、引脚宏映射
    └── src/
        └── gt911.c                     # 驱动主逻辑 (550行)
```

### 2. Kconfig 配置项

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/touch/gt911/Kconfig`

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|--------|------|--------|------|
| `AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911` | bool | n | 启用 GT911，自动选择 `AIC_I2C_DRV` |
| `AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911_I2C_CHA` | string | `"i2c3"` | I2C 总线名 |
| `AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911_RST_PIN` | string | `"PA.8"` | Reset 引脚 |
| `AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911_INT_PIN` | string | `"PA.9"` | Interrupt 引脚 |

这些 Kconfig 值通过宏映射到代码中（`gt911.h` 第 42-44 行）：
```c
#define GT911_I2C_CHAN  AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911_I2C_CHA   // -> "i2c3"
#define GT911_RST_PIN   AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911_RST_PIN   // -> "PA.8"
#define GT911_INT_PIN   AIC_TOUCH_PANEL_GT911_INT_PIN   // -> "PA.9"
```

### 3. GT911 GPIO 引脚配置 (RST/INT)

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/touch/gt911/src/gt911.c`

GPIO 配置分为两个阶段：

**阶段 A - 底层 HAL 配置** (`rt_gt911_gpio_cfg()`, 第 511-530 行)：
```c
// RST: 调用 ArtInChip HAL 层设置为输入模式
pin = drv_pin_get("PA.8");           // drv_pin_get -> hal_gpio_name2pin()
hal_gpio_direction_input(g, p);

// INT: 设置为输入模式 + 下降沿中断
pin = drv_pin_get("PA.9");
hal_gpio_direction_input(g, p);
hal_gpio_set_irq_mode(g, p, 0);     // 0 = 下降沿触发
```

**阶段 B - 硬件初始化时序** (`rt_hw_gt911_init()`, 第 441-509 行)：
```
RST 引脚操作序列：
  1. RST -> OUTPUT, LOW      (复位拉低)
  2. 等待 10ms
  3. INT -> OUTPUT, LOW       (INT 拉低)
  4. 等待 2ms
  5. RST -> OUTPUT, HIGH      (复位释放)
  6. 等待 5ms
  7. RST -> INPUT             (切换为输入，浮空)
  8. INT -> OUTPUT, LOW       (再次拉低 INT)
  9. 等待 50ms
  10. INT -> INPUT            (释放 INT，配置为中断输入)
```

这个时序序列的目的是：在 RST 释放后、INT 释放前，通过 INT 引脚的高低电平组合来设置 GT911 的 I2C 地址（此序列选择 `0x5D` 高地址模式）。

### 4. GT911 与 I2C HAL 的对接方式

**文件**: `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/luban-lite/bsp/peripheral/touch/gt911/src/gt911.c`

对接通过 RT-Thread 标准 I2C 客户端框架：

**I2C 设备获取**（第 480-492 行）：
```c
// 通过设备名 "i2c3" 查找 I2C 总线设备
gt911_client.bus = (struct rt_i2c_bus_device *)rt_device_find("i2c3");
// 以读写模式打开
rt_device_open((rt_device_t)gt911_client.bus, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDWR);
// 设置 GT911 的 I2C 从机地址
gt911_client.client_addr = 0x5D;
```

**I2C 写操作** (`gt911_write_reg()`, 第 45-60 行)：
```c
// 单条 I2C 写消息
msgs.addr  = dev->client_addr;  // 0x5D
msgs.flags = RT_I2C_WR;
msgs.buf   = data;
msgs.len   = len;
rt_i2c_transfer(dev->bus, &msgs, 1);
```

**I2C 读操作** (`gt911_read_regs()`, 第 62-82 行)：
```c
// 典型的"写寄存器地址 + 读数据"两段式 I2C 传输
msgs[0].flags = RT_I2C_WR;  msgs[0].buf = reg;  msgs[0].len = 2;  // 发送 2 字节寄存器地址
msgs[1].flags = RT_I2C_RD;  msgs[1].buf = data;  msgs[1].len = len; // 读取数据
rt_i2c_transfer(dev->bus, msgs, 2);
```

所有 I2C 地址为 2 字节（`GT911_REGITER_LEN = 2`），高字节在前。

### 5. GT911 如何注册为 RT-Thread 设备

**注册入口** (`rt_hw_gt911_port()`, 第 532-548 行)：
```c
static int rt_hw_gt911_port(void)
{
    rt_gt911_gpio_cfg();                              // (1) HAL GPIO 初始化
    rst_pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_RST_PIN);            // (2) 解析引脚
    cfg.dev_name = GT911_I2C_CHAN;                    // (3) 填充配置
    cfg.irq_pin.pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_INT_PIN);
    cfg.irq_pin.mode = PIN_MODE_INPUT;
    cfg.user_data = &rst_pin;                         // (4) RST 引脚通过 user_data 传递
    rt_hw_gt911_init("gt911", &cfg);                 // (5) 初始化并注册
}
INIT_DEVICE_EXPORT(rt_hw_gt911_port);                 // 自动初始化段，系统启动时调用
```

**设备注册** (`rt_hw_gt911_init()`, 第 441-509 行)：
```c
// 1. 分配 rt_touch_device 结构体
touch_device = rt_malloc(sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));

// 2. 硬件初始化时序（RST/INT 操作，见上文）

// 3. 打开 I2C 总线
gt911_client.bus = rt_device_find(cfg->dev_name);
rt_device_open(gt911_client.bus, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDWR);

// 4. 填充触摸设备信息
touch_device->info.type = RT_TOUCH_TYPE_CAPACITANCE;
touch_device->info.vendor = RT_TOUCH_VENDOR_GT;
touch_device->ops = &gt911_touch_ops;    // 注册操作函数表

// 5. 调用 RT-Thread 框架注册
rt_hw_touch_register(touch_device, "gt911", RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX, RT_NULL);
```

**RT-Thread 框架层注册** (`touch.c`, 第 216-253 行)：
- `rt_hw_touch_register()` 将 `rt_touch_device` 注册为 `RT_Device_Class_Touch` 类型设备
- 设备 ops 映射：`open -> rt_touch_open`, `read -> rt_touch_read`, `control -> rt_touch_control`
- 设备名：`"gt911"`，标志：`RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX | RT_DEVICE_FLAG_STANDALONE`

**GT911 驱动操作函数表**（第 436-439 行）：
```c
static struct rt_touch_ops gt911_touch_ops = {
    .touch_readpoint = gt911_read_point,   // I2C 读取触摸坐标
    .touch_control   = gt911_control,       // 配置/获取信息
};
```

### 6. 触摸事件如何传递到 LVGL

触摸数据从硬件到 LVGL 经过 **4 层**：

```
硬件 GT911
    |
    | [I2C + GPIO 中断]
    v
RT-Thread Touch Framework (touch.c)
    |
    | [rt_device_read() -> touch->ops->touch_readpoint()]
    v
lv_tpc_run.c - 触摸轮询线程
    |
    | [aic_touch_inputevent_cb(x, y, event)]
    v
lv_port_indev.c - LVGL 输入设备适配
    |
    | [lv_indev_drv_t.read_cb = input_read]
    v
LVGL 内核 (lv_indev_read)
```

**详细步骤：**

**Step 1 - 中断触发**: GT911 检测到触摸 -> INT 引脚电平变化 -> RT-Thread pin irq 回调 -> `touch_irq_callback()` -> `rt_hw_touch_isr()` -> `touch->parent.rx_indicate()` -> 释放信号量

**Step 2 - tpc_run 线程读取** (`lv_tpc_run.c`, 第 34-68 行)：
```c
// 线程等待信号量（由中断回调释放）
rt_sem_take(gt911_sem, RT_WAITING_FOREVER);
// 读取触摸数据
int num = rt_device_read(dev, 0, read_data, info.point_num);
// rt_device_read -> rt_touch_read -> gt911_read_point() [通过I2C读取坐标]
// 遍历每个触摸点，调用回调
aic_touch_inputevent_cb(u16X, u16Y, read_data[i].event);
// 重新使能中断
rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_ENABLE_INT, RT_NULL);
```

**Step 3 - LVGL 适配层** (`lv_port_indev.c`, 第 30-44 行)：
```c
void aic_touch_inputevent_cb(rt_int16_t x, rt_int16_t y, rt_uint8_t state)
{
    switch (state) {
    case RT_TOUCH_EVENT_UP:    last_state = LV_INDEV_STATE_RELEASED; break;
    case RT_TOUCH_EVENT_MOVE:
    case RT_TOUCH_EVENT_DOWN:  last_x = x; last_y = y;
                               last_state = LV_INDEV_STATE_PRESSED; break;
    }
}
```

**Step 4 - LVGL 读取回调** (`lv_port_indev.c`, 第 23-28 行)：
```c
static void input_read(lv_indev_drv_t *indev_drv, lv_indev_data_t *data)
{
    data->point.x = last_x;
    data->point.y = last_y;
    data->state = last_state;
}
```

**Step 5 - tpc_run 的启动点** (`lv_port_disp.c`, 第 367-370 行)：
```c
#ifdef KERNEL_RTTHREAD
    tpc_run("gt911", info.width, info.height);  // 在显示驱动初始化时启动触摸线程
#endif
```

**注意**：`lv_port_indev_init()` 中也注册了 LVGL 输入设备（`lv_indev_drv_register`），但实际的触摸数据传递是通过 `aic_touch_inputevent_cb()` 回调间接触发的，而不是通过 `input_read()` 主动轮询。`input_read()` 读取的是由 `aic_touch_inputevent_cb()` 更新的全局变量 `last_x`, `last_y`, `last_state`。

### 7. 完整调用链总结

```
系统启动
  └─ INIT_DEVICE_EXPORT(rt_hw_gt911_port)      // 自动初始化段
       ├─ rt_gt911_gpio_cfg()                    // HAL GPIO 配置 RST/INT
       │    ├─ drv_pin_get("PA.8") -> hal_gpio_name2pin()
       │    ├─ hal_gpio_direction_input(RST)
       │    ├─ drv_pin_get("PA.9") -> hal_gpio_name2pin()
       │    ├─ hal_gpio_direction_input(INT)
       │    └─ hal_gpio_set_irq_mode(INT, 下降沿)
       └─ rt_hw_gt911_init("gt911", &cfg)       // 设备初始化
            ├─ GPIO 时序: RST LOW->HIGH->INPUT, INT LOW->LOW->INPUT
            ├─ rt_device_find("i2c3")            // 获取 I2C 总线
            ├─ rt_device_open(bus, RDWR)          // 打开 I2C 总线
            ├─ 设置 gt911_client.client_addr = 0x5D
            ├─ 填充 touch_device (type=CAPACITANCE, vendor=GT)
            └─ rt_hw_touch_register(touch, "gt911", INT_RX)
                 └─ rt_device_register() -> 设备名 "gt911", 类型 RT_Device_Class_Touch

触摸事件发生
  └─ GT911 INT 引脚中断
       └─ touch_irq_callback()
            └─ rt_hw_touch_isr()
                 ├─ touch->irq_handle(touch)  [如有]
                 └─ touch->parent.rx_indicate(dev, 1)  // 通知有数据

lv_port_disp_init() 被调用
  └─ tpc_run("gt911", w, h)                    // 启动触摸处理线程
       ├─ rt_device_find("gt911")               // 查找触摸设备
       ├─ rt_device_open(dev, INT_RX)            // 打开设备，初始化中断
       │    └─ rt_touch_irq_init()               // 配置 INT 引脚中断
       ├─ rt_device_set_rx_indicate(rx_callback) // 注册中断回调
       │    └─ rx_callback: 释放信号量 + 禁用中断
       └─ rt_thread_create("gt911", gt911_entry) // 创建处理线程
            └─ gt911_entry 循环:
                 ├─ rt_sem_take(信号量)           // 等待中断
                 ├─ rt_device_read(dev, read_data) // 读取触摸点
                 │    └─ rt_touch_read()
                 │         └─ gt911_read_point()   // I2C 读取 GT911 寄存器
                 │              ├─ I2C 读 0x814E (状态)
                 │              ├─ I2C 读 0x814F (坐标数据)
                 │              └─ 填充 rt_touch_data (event/x/y)
                 ├─ aic_touch_inputevent_cb(x, y, event) // 更新全局状态
                 │    └─ 更新 last_x, last_y, last_state
                 └─ rt_device_control(ENABLE_INT)  // 重新使能中断

LVGL tick 回调
  └─ input_read()
       └─ 读取 last_x, last_y, last_state
            └─ LVGL 内核处理触摸输入

157: static void transform_upscaled(const lv_draw_img_dsc_t *draw_dsc, int32_t xin,
158:                                int32_t yin, int32_t * xout, int32_t * yout)
159: {
160:     int32_t pivot_x_256 = draw_dsc->pivot.x * 256;
161:     int32_t pivot_y_256 = draw_dsc->pivot.y * 256;
162:     int32_t zoom = (256 * 256) / draw_dsc->zoom;
163: 
164:     xin -= draw_dsc->pivot.x;
165:     yin -= draw_dsc->pivot.y;
166: 
167:     if (draw_dsc->angle == 0) {
168:         *xout = (int32_t)(xin * zoom) + pivot_x_256;
169:         *yout = (int32_t)(yin * zoom) + pivot_y_256;
170:     } else {
171:         int32_t sinma;
172:         int32_t cosma;
173:         int32_t angle = -draw_dsc->angle;
174:         int32_t angle_low = angle / 10;
175:         int32_t angle_high = angle_low + 1;
176:         int32_t angle_rem = angle - (angle_low * 10);
177:         int32_t s1 = lv_trigo_sin(angle_low);
178:         int32_t s2 = lv_trigo_sin(angle_high);
179:         int32_t c1 = lv_trigo_sin(angle_low + 90);
180:         int32_t c2 = lv_trigo_sin(angle_high + 90);
181: 
182:         sinma = (s1 * (10 - angle_rem) + s2 * angle_rem) / 10;
183:         cosma = (c1 * (10 - angle_rem) + c2 * angle_rem) / 10;
184:         sinma = sinma >> (LV_TRIGO_SHIFT - 10);
185:         cosma = cosma >> (LV_TRIGO_SHIFT - 10);
186: 
187:         if (zoom == LV_IMG_ZOOM_NONE) {
188:             *xout = ((cosma * xin - sinma * yin) >> 2) + (pivot_x_256);
189:             *yout = ((sinma * xin + cosma * yin) >> 2) + (pivot_y_256);
190:         } else {
191:             *xout = (((cosma * xin - sinma * yin) * zoom) >> 10) + (pivot_x_256);
192:             *yout = (((sinma * xin + cosma * yin) * zoom) >> 10) + (pivot_y_256);
193:         }
194:     }
195: }

404:     int32_t zoom = 256;
405:     int out_w = 0;
406:     int out_h = 0;
407:     int out_stride = 0;
408:     int out_size = 0;
409:     u32 out_addr = 0;
410:     u32 out_addr_align = 0;
411:     int out_pivot_x = 0;
412:     int out_pivot_y = 0;
413: 
414:     /* src buf */
415:     rot.src_buf.buf_type = MPP_PHY_ADDR;

417:         || frame->buf.format == MPP_FMT_RGBA_8888

428:             rot.src_rot_center.y = draw_dsc->pivot.y;

433:             zoom =  draw_dsc->zoom;
434:             out_w = (frame->buf.size.width * zoom) >> 8;

442:                 LV_LOG_ERROR("malloc fail\n");
443:                 goto failed;
444:             }
445: 
446:             out_addr_align = ALIGN_1024B(out_addr);
447:             aicos_dcache_clean_invalid_range((ulong *)((ulong)out_addr_align), ALIGN_UP(out_size, CACHE_LINE_SIZE));
448: 
449:             /* src buf */
450:             blt.src_buf.buf_type = MPP_PHY_ADDR;
451:             blt.src_buf.phy_addr[0] = frame->buf.phy_addr[0];
452:             blt.src_buf.stride[0] = frame->buf.stride[0];
453:             blt.src_buf.format = frame->buf.format;
454:             blt.src_buf.size.width = frame->buf.size.width;
455:             blt.src_buf.size.height = frame->buf.size.height;
456: 
457:             /* dst buf */
458:             blt.dst_buf.buf_type = MPP_PHY_ADDR;
459:             blt.dst_buf.phy_addr[0] = out_addr_align;
460:             blt.dst_buf.stride[0] = out_stride;
461:             blt.dst_buf.format = frame->buf.format;
462:             blt.dst_buf.size.width = out_w;
463:             blt.dst_buf.size.height = out_h;
464: 
465:             ret = mpp_ge_bitblt(g_ge, &blt);
466:             if (ret < 0) {
467:                 LV_LOG_ERROR("bitblt fail\n");
468:                 goto failed;
469:             }
470:             ret = mpp_ge_emit(g_ge);
471:             if (ret < 0) {
472:                 LV_LOG_ERROR("emit fail\n");
473:                 goto failed;
474:             }
475:             ret = mpp_ge_sync(g_ge);
476:             if (ret < 0) {
477:                 LV_LOG_ERROR("sync fail\n");
478:                 goto failed;
479:             }
480: 
481:             rot.src_buf.phy_addr[0] = out_addr_align;
482:             rot.src_buf.stride[0] = out_stride;
483:             rot.src_buf.format = frame->buf.format;
484:             rot.src_buf.size.width = out_w;
485:             rot.src_buf.size.height = out_h;
486:             rot.src_rot_center.x = out_pivot_x;
487:             rot.src_rot_center.y = out_pivot_y;
488:         }
489:     } else {
490:         LV_LOG_ERROR("frame unsupport format:%d\n", frame->buf.format);
491:         return LV_RES_INV;
492:     }
493: 
494:     /* dst buf */
495: #ifdef USE_DRAW_BUF
496:     rot.dst_buf.buf_type = MPP_PHY_ADDR;
497:     if (dest_buf == (lv_color_t *)g_draw_buf[0])
498:         rot.dst_buf.phy_addr[0] = (unsigned int)(long)g_draw_buf[0];
499:     else
500:         rot.dst_buf.phy_addr[0] = (unsigned int)(long)g_draw_buf[1];
501: #else
502:     rot.dst_buf.buf_type = MPP_PHY_ADDR;
503:     if (dest_buf == (lv_color_t *)g_frame_buf[0])
504:         rot.dst_buf.phy_addr[0] = (unsigned int)(long)g_frame_buf[0];
505:     else
506:         rot.dst_buf.phy_addr[0] = (unsigned int)(long)g_frame_buf[1];
507: #endif
508:     rot.dst_buf.stride[0] = line_length;
509:     rot.dst_buf.size.width = dest_width;
510:     rot.dst_buf.size.height = dest_height;
511:     rot.dst_buf.format = fmt;
512:     rot.dst_buf.crop_en = 0;
513:     rot.dst_buf.crop.x = blend_area->x1;
514:     rot.dst_buf.crop.y = blend_area->y1;
515:     rot.dst_buf.crop.width = blend_width;
516:     rot.dst_buf.crop.height = blend_height;
517:     rot.dst_rot_center.x = coords->x1 + draw_dsc->pivot.x;
518:     rot.dst_rot_center.y = coords->y1 + draw_dsc->pivot.y;
519: 
520:     /* angle */
521:     rot.angle_sin = SIN((double)draw_dsc->angle / 10) * 4096;
522:     rot.angle_cos = COS((double)draw_dsc->angle / 10) * 4096;
523: 
524:     /* ctrl */
525:     rot.ctrl.flags = 0;
526:     rot.ctrl.alpha_en = 1;
527:     rot.ctrl.src_alpha_mode = 2;
528:     rot.ctrl.src_global_alpha = draw_dsc->opa;
529: 
530:     aicos_dcache_clean_invalid_range((ulong *)dest_buf, (ulong)ALIGN_UP(draw_buf_len(), CACHE_LINE_SIZE));
531:     ret = mpp_ge_rotate(g_ge, &rot);
532:     if (ret < 0) {
533:         LV_LOG_WARN("rotate fail\n");
534:         goto failed;
535:     }
536:     ret = mpp_ge_emit(g_ge);
537:     if (ret < 0) {
538:         LV_LOG_WARN("emit fail\n");
539:         goto failed;
540:     }
541:     ret = mpp_ge_sync(g_ge);
542:     if (ret < 0) {
543:         LV_LOG_WARN("sync fail\n");
544:         goto failed;
545:     }
546: 
547:     if (out_addr)
548:         aicos_free(MEM_CMA, (void*)(unsigned long)out_addr);
549: 
550:     return LV_RES_OK;
551: 
552: failed:
553:     if (out_addr)
554:         aicos_free(MEM_CMA, (void*)(unsigned long)out_addr);
555: 
556:     return LV_RES_INV;
557: }

559: static inline void rgb565_to_argb(unsigned short src_pixel, unsigned int* dst_color)
560: {
561:     unsigned int a, r, g, b;
562: 
563:     a = 0xff;
564:     r = ((src_pixel & 0xf800) >> 8);
565:     g = (src_pixel & 0x07e0) >> 3;
566:     b = (src_pixel & 0x1f) << 3;
567: 
568:     *dst_color = (a << 24) | ((r | (r >> 5)) << 16) |
569:         ((g | (g >> 6)) << 8) | (b | (b >> 5));
570: 
571: }

657: static lv_res_t hw_decode(lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx, const lv_draw_img_dsc_t *draw_dsc,
658:                     const void *src, const lv_area_t *blend_area, const lv_area_t *coords)
659: {
660:     struct decode_config config = { 0 };
661:     int ret;
662:     struct mpp_decoder* dec;
663:     struct mpp_frame frame;
664:     img_info *info;
665:     int type;
666:     int lv_ret = LV_RES_OK;
667: 
668:     info = img_info_init(src);
669:     if(!info) return LV_RES_INV;
670: 
671:     type = info->type ?
672:         MPP_CODEC_VIDEO_DECODER_PNG:MPP_CODEC_VIDEO_DECODER_MJPEG;
673: 
674:     config.bitstream_buffer_size = (info->img_size + 1023) & (~1023);
675:     config.extra_frame_num = 0;
676:     config.packet_count = 1;
677:     if(type == MPP_CODEC_VIDEO_DECODER_MJPEG)
678:         config.pix_fmt = MPP_FMT_YUV420P;
679:     else if(type == MPP_CODEC_VIDEO_DECODER_PNG)
680:         config.pix_fmt = MPP_FMT_ARGB_8888;
681: 
682:     dec = mpp_decoder_create(type);
683: 
684:     if (!dec) {
685:         lv_ret = LV_RES_INV;
686:         LV_LOG_ERROR("mpp_decoder_create failed\n");
687:         goto free_img;
688:     }
689:     mpp_decoder_init(dec, &config);
690: 
691:     struct mpp_packet packet;
692:     mpp_decoder_get_packet(dec, &packet, info->img_size);
693:     uint32_t len = 0;
694:     lv_fs_read(&(info->fp), packet.data, info->img_size, &len);
695:     packet.size = info->img_size;
696:     packet.flag = PACKET_FLAG_EOS;
697: 
698:     mpp_decoder_put_packet(dec, &packet);
699:     mpp_decoder_decode(dec);
700:     ret = mpp_decoder_get_frame(dec, &frame);
701:     if (ret < 0) {
702:         lv_ret = LV_RES_INV;
703:         LV_LOG_ERROR("mpp decoder get frame failed:%d\n", ret);
704:         goto free_dec;
705:     }
706: 
707:     if (is_fix_angle(draw_dsc->angle))
708:         lv_ret = ge_run_blit(draw_ctx, draw_dsc, &frame, blend_area, coords);
709:     else if (draw_dsc->angle > 0 && draw_dsc->zoom == LV_IMG_ZOOM_NONE)
710:         lv_ret = ge_run_rotate(draw_ctx, draw_dsc, &frame, blend_area, coords);
711:     else
712:         lv_ret = LV_RES_INV;
713: 
714:     mpp_decoder_put_frame(dec, &frame);
715: free_dec:
716:     mpp_decoder_destory(dec);
717: free_img:
718:     img_info_deinit(info);
719: 
720:     return lv_ret;
721: }

738:     } else {
739:         file_type = true;

744:     else

757:     blend_dsc.blend_mode = draw_dsc->blend_mode;

760:     if (!mask_any && draw_dsc->recolor_opa == LV_OPA_TRANSP) {
761:         blend_dsc.src_buf = NULL;
762:         blend_dsc.blend_area = coords;
763:         lv_area_t blend_area;

765:         if (!transform) {
766:             //lv_area_copy(&blend_area, coords);

792:         } else {
793:             LV_LOG_USER("lv res inv\n");
794:             return LV_RES_INV;
795:         }
796:     }
797:     return LV_RES_OK;

54: static int get_jpeg_format(uint8_t *buf, enum mpp_pixel_format *pix_fmt)
55: {
56:     int i;
57:     uint8_t h_count[3] = { 0 };
58:     uint8_t v_count[3] = { 0 };
59:     uint8_t nb_components = *buf++;
60: 
61:     for (i = 0; i < nb_components; i++) {
62:         uint8_t h_v_cnt;
63: 
64:         /* skip component id */
65:         buf++;
66:         h_v_cnt = *buf++;
67:         h_count[i] = h_v_cnt >> 4;
68:         v_count[i] = h_v_cnt & 0xf;
69: 
70:         /*skip quant_index*/
71:         buf++;
72:     }
73: 
74:     if (h_count[0] == 2 && v_count[0] == 2 && h_count[1] == 1 &&
75:         v_count[1] == 1 && h_count[2] == 1 && v_count[2] == 1) {
76:         *pix_fmt = MPP_FMT_YUV420P;
77:     } else if (h_count[0] == 4 && v_count[0] == 1 && h_count[1] == 1 &&
78:                v_count[1] == 1 && h_count[2] == 1 && v_count[2] == 1) {
79:         return -1;
80:     } else if (h_count[0] == 2 && v_count[0] == 1 && h_count[1] == 1 &&
81:                v_count[1] == 1 && h_count[2] == 1 && v_count[2] == 1) {
82:         *pix_fmt = MPP_FMT_YUV422P;
83:     } else if (h_count[0] == 1 && v_count[0] == 1 && h_count[1] == 1 &&
84:                v_count[1] == 1 && h_count[2] == 1 && v_count[2] == 1) {
85:         *pix_fmt = MPP_FMT_YUV444P;
86:     } else if (h_count[0] == 1 && v_count[0] == 2 && h_count[1] == 1 &&
87:                v_count[1] == 2 && h_count[2] == 1 && v_count[2] == 2) {
88:         *pix_fmt = MPP_FMT_YUV444P;
89:     } else if (h_count[0] == 1 && v_count[0] == 2 && h_count[1] == 1 &&
90:                v_count[1] == 1 && h_count[2] == 1 && v_count[2] == 1) {
91:         return -1;
92:     } else if (h_count[1] == 0 && v_count[1] == 0 && h_count[2] == 0 &&

112: static lv_fs_res_t jpeg_get_img_size(lv_fs_file_t *fp, int *w, int *h, enum mpp_pixel_format *pix_fmt)
113: {
114:     uint32_t read_num;
115:     uint8_t buf[128];
116:     lv_fs_res_t res = LV_RES_OK;
117: 
118:     // read JPEG SOI
119:     res = lv_fs_read(fp, buf, 2, &read_num);
120:     if (res != LV_FS_RES_OK || read_num != 2) {
121:         res = LV_RES_INV;
122:         goto read_err;
123:     }
124: 
125:     /* check SOI */
126:     if (stream_to_u16(buf) != JPEG_SOI) {
127:         res = LV_RES_INV;
128:         goto read_err;
129:     }
130: 
131:     /* find SOF */
132:     while (1) {
133:         int size;
134:         res = lv_fs_read(fp, buf, 4, &read_num);
135:         if (res != LV_FS_RES_OK || read_num != 4) {
136:             res = LV_RES_INV;
137:             goto read_err;
138:         }
139: 
140:         if (stream_to_u16(buf) == JPEG_SOF) {
141:             res = lv_fs_read(fp, buf, 15, &read_num);
142:             if (res != LV_FS_RES_OK) {
143:                 res = LV_RES_INV;
144:                 goto read_err;
145:             }
146: 
147:             *h = stream_to_u16(buf + 1);
148:             *w = stream_to_u16(buf + 3);
149: 
150:             get_jpeg_format(buf + 5, pix_fmt);
151:             break;
152:         } else {
153:             size = stream_to_u16(buf + 2);
154:             lv_fs_seek(fp, size - 2, SEEK_CUR);
155:             if (res != LV_FS_RES_OK) {
156:                 res = LV_RES_INV;
157:                 goto read_err;
158:             }
159:         }
160:     }
161: 
162: read_err:
163:     return res;

478: static int angle2speed(int angle)
479: {
480:     float speed;
481:     float ratio;
482:     float range;
483: 
484:     range = (360 - 255 + 105);
485: 
486:     if (angle >= 255 && angle < 360)
487:         speed = (float)(angle - 255);
488:     else
489:         speed = (float)(angle + 360 - 255);
490: 
491:     if (speed > 0) {
492:         ratio = 160.0 / range;
493:         speed = speed * ratio;
494:     }
495: 
496:     return (int)speed;
497: }

44: static int angle2speed(int angle)
45: {
46:     float speed;
47:     float ratio;
48:     float range;
49: 
50:     range = (360 - 255 + 105);
51: 
52:     if (angle >= 255 && angle < 360)
53:         speed = (float)(angle - 255);
54:     else
55:         speed = (float)(angle + 360 - 255);
56: 
57:     if (speed > 0) {
58:         ratio = 160.0 / range;
59:         speed = speed * ratio;
60:     }
61: 
62:     return (int)speed;
63: }

76:         rot_angle = 359;

78:     if (rot_direct == 0 && rot_angle == 106) {
79:         rot_angle = 104;

172: static int16_t pre_x[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };
173: static int16_t pre_y[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };
174: static int16_t pre_w[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };

178: static void gt911_touch_up(void *buf, int8_t id)
179: {
180:     read_data = (struct rt_touch_data *)buf;
181: 
182:     if (s_tp_dowm[id] == 1) {
183:         s_tp_dowm[id] = 0;
184:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_UP;
185:     } else {
186:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_NONE;
187:     }
188: 
189:     read_data[id].timestamp = rt_touch_get_ts();
190:     read_data[id].width = pre_w[id];
191:     read_data[id].x_coordinate = pre_x[id];
192:     read_data[id].y_coordinate = pre_y[id];
193:     read_data[id].track_id = id;
194: 
195:     pre_x[id] = -1; /* last point is none */
196:     pre_y[id] = -1;
197:     pre_w[id] = -1;
198: }

200: static void gt911_touch_down(void *buf, int8_t id, int16_t x, int16_t y,
201:                              int16_t w)
202: {
203:     read_data = (struct rt_touch_data *)buf;
204: 
205:     if (s_tp_dowm[id] == 1) {
206:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_MOVE;
207:     } else {
208:         read_data[id].event = RT_TOUCH_EVENT_DOWN;
209:         s_tp_dowm[id] = 1;
210:     }
211: 
212:     read_data[id].timestamp = rt_touch_get_ts();
213:     read_data[id].width = w;
214:     read_data[id].x_coordinate = x;
215:     read_data[id].y_coordinate = y;
216:     read_data[id].track_id = id;
217: 
218:     pre_x[id] = x; /* save last point */
219:     pre_y[id] = y;
220:     pre_w[id] = w;
221: }

223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

338: static rt_err_t gt911_control(struct rt_touch_device *touch, int cmd, void *arg)
339: {
340:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_ID) {
341:         return gt911_get_product_id(&gt911_client, arg, 6);
342:     }
343: 
344:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO) {
345:         return gt911_get_info(&gt911_client, arg);
346:     }
347: 
348:     rt_uint8_t buf[4];
349:     rt_uint8_t i = 0;
350:     rt_uint8_t *config;
351: 
352:     config =
353:         (rt_uint8_t *)rt_calloc(1, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_REGITER_LEN);
354:     if (config == RT_NULL) {
355:         LOG_D("malloc config memory failed\n");
356:         return -RT_ERROR;
357:     }
358: 
359:     config[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CONFIG_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
360:     config[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CONFIG_REG & 0xFF);
361: 
362:     memcpy(&config[2], GT911_CFG_TBL, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL));
363: 
364:     switch (cmd) {
365:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE: {
366:             rt_uint16_t x_range;
367: 
368:             x_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
369:             config[4] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range >> 8);
370:             config[3] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range & 0xff);
371: 
372:             GT911_CFG_TBL[2] = config[4];
373:             GT911_CFG_TBL[1] = config[3];
374:             break;
375:         }
376:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE: {
377:             rt_uint16_t y_range;
378: 
379:             y_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
380:             config[6] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range >> 8);
381:             config[5] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range & 0xff);
382: 
383:             GT911_CFG_TBL[4] = config[6];
384:             GT911_CFG_TBL[3] = config[5];
385:             break;
386:         }
387:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_TO_Y: {
388:             config[8] ^= (1 << 3);
389:             break;
390:         }
391:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_MODE: {
392:             rt_uint16_t trig_type;
393:             trig_type = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
394: 
395:             switch (trig_type) {
396:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX:
397:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
398:                     break;
399:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDONLY:
400:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
401:                     config[8] |= 0x02;
402:                     break;
403:                 default:
404:                     break;
405:             }
406:             break;
407:         }
408:         default: {
409:             break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:     if (gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, config,
414:                         sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN) != RT_EOK) {
415:         LOG_D("send config failed");
416:         return -1;
417:     }
418: 
419:     buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CHECK_SUM >> 8) & 0xFF);
420:     buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CHECK_SUM & 0xFF);
421:     buf[2] = 0;
422: 
423:     for (i = GT911_ADDR_LEN; i < sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
424:         buf[GT911_ADDR_LEN] += config[i];
425:     }
426: 
427:     buf[2] = (~buf[2]) + 1;
428:     buf[3] = 1;
429: 
430:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, buf, 4);
431:     rt_free(config);
432: 
433:     return RT_EOK;
434: }

441: static int rt_hw_gt911_init(const char *name, struct rt_touch_config *cfg)
442: {
443:     struct rt_touch_device *touch_device = RT_NULL;
444: 
445:     touch_device =
446:         (struct rt_touch_device *)rt_malloc(sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
447:     if (touch_device == RT_NULL) {
448:         LOG_E("touch device malloc fail");
449:         return -RT_ERROR;
450:     }
451:     rt_memset((void *)touch_device, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
452: 
453:     /* hw init*/
454:     // rst output 0
455:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
456:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_LOW);
457:     rt_thread_delay(10);
458: 
459:     // irq output 0
460:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
461:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
462: 
463:     rt_thread_delay(2);
464:     // rst output 1
465:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
466:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_HIGH);
467: 
468:     rt_thread_delay(5);
469:     // rst input
470:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
471: 
472:     //irq output 0
473:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
474:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
475: 
476:     rt_thread_delay(50);
477: 
478:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
479: 
480:     gt911_client.bus =
481:         (struct rt_i2c_bus_device *)rt_device_find(cfg->dev_name);
482: 
483:     if (gt911_client.bus == RT_NULL) {
484:         LOG_E("Can't find %s device", cfg->dev_name);
485:         return -RT_ERROR;
486:     }
487: 
488:     if (rt_device_open((rt_device_t)gt911_client.bus, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDWR) !=
489:         RT_EOK) {
490:         LOG_E("open %s device failed", cfg->dev_name);
491:         return -RT_ERROR;
492:     }
493: 
494:     gt911_client.client_addr = GT911_ADDRESS_HIGH;
495: 
496:     /* register touch device */
497:     touch_device->info.type = RT_TOUCH_TYPE_CAPACITANCE;
498:     touch_device->info.vendor = RT_TOUCH_VENDOR_GT;
499:     rt_memcpy(&touch_device->config, cfg, sizeof(struct rt_touch_config));
500:     touch_device->ops = &gt911_touch_ops;
501: 
502:     if (RT_EOK != rt_hw_touch_register(touch_device, name, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX, RT_NULL)) {
503:         LOG_E("touch device gt911 init failed !!!");
504:         return -RT_ERROR;
505:     }
506: 
507:     LOG_I("touch device gt911 init success");
508:     return RT_EOK;
509: }

692:         else:

699:             cmdstr += '--imgsize {} '.format(data_siz)
700:             cmdstr += '--cluster {} '.format(cluster)
701:             cmdstr += '--sector {} '.format(sector_siz)
702:             cmdstr += '--tooldir {} '.format(aic_script_dir)
703:             cmdstr += '--inputdir {} '.format(srcdir)
704:             cmdstr += '--outfile {}\n'.format(outimg)

708:             print('imgsize:{}'.format(imgsize))

712:     if get_config(prj_root_dir + '.config', littlefs_enable) == 'y':

718:         pagesiz_opt = 'CONFIG_AIC_LITTLEFS_PAGE_SIZE_FOR_{}'.format(img_id)
